Name: Puah, Father of Tola
Summary: Puah is named only as the father of Tola the judge, in the line of Dodo. He is distinct from Puah the midwife in Exodus.
KeyStory: Puah appears in Judges only as Tola's father.
RelatedPeople: Tola, Son of Puah; Dodo, Father of Puah
LifeLesson: Two people can share a name and nothing else — the line, not the name, tells them apart.
